description: This Java source file defines the class TabHelperHoneycomb, which provides tab management functionalities using the ActionBar API on Honeycomb (Android API level 11). It manages fragment transactions tied to tabs, preserves tab state, and integrates with the support library for backward compatibility.

classes.name: TabHelperHoneycomb
classes.description: A helper class for managing action bar tabs on Honeycomb with support for fragment transactions and state preservation.

methods.name: TabHelperHoneycomb
methods.description: Constructor initializing TabHelperHoneycomb with a given FragmentActivity.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActionBar and sets its navigation mode to tabs if not already set.

methods.name: addTab
methods.description: Adds a tab to the ActionBar, manages associated fragment, and ensures proper state handling.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current selected tab position into the provided Bundle.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the tab selection from saved state.
